methods.name: MICUNet3+
methods.summary: A landslide mapping method that combines Independent Component Analysis (ICA) for feature processing of optical-derived NDVI, GLCM, and topographic factors, with a UNet3+ deep learning architecture for semantic segmentation, utilizing full-scale skip connections and deep supervision.
methods.verbatim: In this study, the multifeatured independent component analysis and UNet3+ (MICUNet3+) method is proposed for landslide inventory mapping... This work was supported in part by... Chang’an University High Performance Computing Platform.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is mentioned but not linked, and other input datasets lack direct links. The custom MICUNet3+ code is mentioned but no repository or persistent link is provided.
